analysis_notes: Exploratory source-held-out analysis assembled after screening the cited source tables.
The source-level labels refer to citations in Su et al. Table S2; the crosswalk is documented in docs/asv_source_selection.md.
The 12 Alchouron compiled response values are replaced by thesis-figure means; the Sun compiled rows are replaced by 30 species-resolved As(V) figure means.
The 138-row analysis input is not bundled in this code repository. Reconstruct it from the cited source SI and articles using Text S7 and the data dictionary.
This branch is separate from the primary IBU, Sr, and Cd analyses and is not independent prospective validation.
